author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

This PR makes the default output of `edmModuleAllocMonitorAnalyze.py` to be a per-module per-transition summary. The previous default output was moved under `--trace` option. A `--summaryField` option is added to show only one of the measured quantities in the summary. Example of the summary output
```
Module label thingProducer, transitions:
  construction
    process (1 calls)
      nAlloc 270 nDealloc 240 added 5744 minTemp 0 maxTemp 7024 max1Alloc 872
  begin job
    process (1 calls)
      nAlloc 2 nDealloc 2 added 0 minTemp 0 maxTemp 672 max1Alloc 513
  begin stream
    process (1 calls)
      nAlloc 2 nDealloc 2 added 0 minTemp 0 maxTemp 672 max1Alloc 513
  global begin run
    process (1 calls)
      nAlloc 6 nDealloc 3 added 304 minTemp 0 maxTemp 672 max1Alloc 513
  global begin lumi
    process (1 calls)
      nAlloc 6 nDealloc 3 added 304 minTemp 0 maxTemp 672 max1Alloc 513
  event
    process (3 calls)
      nAlloc 7 nDealloc 4 added 304 minTemp 0 maxTemp 672 max1Alloc 513
``` 

Made with AI assistance.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2360

#### PR validation:

Unit tests pass
title: Add a per-module summary output to `edmModuleAllocMonitorAnalyze.py` and make it the default
